title: Welcome to September at The Anchor
preheader: Lunch is now served Tuesday to Friday, and there are four nights out still to come this month.

data.heading: Welcome to September
body: The nights are drawing in, which is the best possible excuse to be in a pub. Here is what is on for the rest of the month, and what has changed since the summer.
The biggest change: we are now open from midday Tuesday to Friday, with lunch served from 12pm to 3pm and dinner from 4pm to 9pm. If you had us down as an evening-only pub, we are not any more.

image.alt: Autumn Kick-Off Quiz Night at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

data.heading: Wednesday 16 September: Autumn Kick-Off Quiz Night
data.body: 7pm start, £3 cash entry, teams of up to six. General knowledge, music, TV and film, plus one round in the middle that you play on your phone. Doors from 6:30pm.

image.alt: Big Sing Friday Karaoke Night at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

data.heading: Friday 18 September: Big Sing Friday Karaoke
data.body: 8pm start and free entry. A huge song list, communal tables and a crowd that will cheer you on whatever you pick.
data.link_label: Let us know you are coming

image.alt: Only Fools and Horses charity quiz night at The Anchor, in aid of Macmillan Cancer Support

data.heading: Friday 25 September: Lovely Jubbly Charity Quiz
data.body: 7pm start, £3 cash entry, and every penny of it goes to Macmillan Cancer Support. Only Fools and Horses themed, and dress-up is welcome.

image.alt: Autumn Jackpot Cash Bingo at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

data.heading: Wednesday 30 September: Autumn Jackpot Cash Bingo
data.body: 7pm start, £10 cash per book. Ten games, a rollover Snowball and a final cash jackpot that grows with every book sold.

data.heading: Opening times
data.footnote: We may stay open until midnight on Fridays, Saturdays and event nights. Last orders are 30 minutes before the kitchen closes, and 15 minutes before the bar does.

image.alt: A Sunday roast at The Anchor, carved beef with roast potatoes and Yorkshire pudding

data.heading: Sunday roast, no pre-order needed
data.body: Roasts are served from 1pm to 6pm every Sunday, with the last seating at 5:30pm. There is nothing to order in advance and no Saturday cutoff. Walk in if you like, though booking is wise for a group or a peak slot.

data.heading: Christmas is open for enquiries
body: Parties run from 10 November to 20 December, with a pre-ordered menu and a £10 per person deposit. Tell us your date and rough numbers and we will come back to you.

data.heading: Coming in October
body: A Hint of Halloween Quiz Night on Wednesday 7 October, Classic Horror Music Bingo on Friday 16 October, and the House of Horrors Halloween party on Saturday 31 October. We will be in touch about each one nearer the time.

data.body: Whether it is lunch, a roast or a quiz team, we would rather see you than not. Book a table or just turn up.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, or because you said you would like to hear from us. That may have been a while ago now, and we are glad you are still with us.
